svg.title: Figure 4. Changing relative valuation and disrupting comparison
svg.desc: Schematic teaching figure. Two psychometric curves of P(choose B) against the offered quantity ratio qB/qA on a log axis. A: the altered curve has the same steepness but its midpoint shifts from 3 to 4. B: the altered curve shares the midpoint at 3 but is shallower. An inset shows the sequential-offer task with weak OFC stimulation during offer 2. Different experimental conditions; analytical curves, not published data. Panel A summarizes the relative-valuation effect in Ballesta et al. (2020); panel B summarizes the weak second-offer stimulation condition in Ballesta et al. (2022). The panels represent separate experimental conditions, not a continuous dose-response series.
